tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search listed public mod source preparations by words and optional category. Returns catalog summaries and pricing policy, not a checkout quote.

tools.name: prepare_cart_link
tools.description: Prepare a public cart link with selected mods. No sign-in is needed to view the selection and price estimate. The buyer signs in and confirms the final total and payment in Checkout.

tools.name: get_mod_details
tools.description: Read a public mod description, supported scope and limitations. Unknown IDs return an error.

tools.name: get_setup_overview
tools.description: Read public setup steps, business questions, verification and local buyer package resource paths. No file access or installation.

tools.name: get_compatibility_guidance
tools.description: Read published support evidence for up to 8 mods alongside the requested environment. This does not inspect a project or certify compatibility.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_compatibility_guidance" appears informational but accepts parameters (environment) that enable code/file/secret access.
